Thanks for the note, Brendan. Quick answers up front: Redwood can accept a notarized wet-ink document that has been scanned (PDF) in most states; several states (notably TX and FL) have stricter requirements depending on how the certificate is used. E-signed affidavits with a traceable audit trail are acceptable in many cases, but our billing team needs to confirm state-specific acceptance.

Lauren (billing) and Kim (tax intake) 94 can you confirm acceptance criteria for this specific account (NorthWave) and PO 6721? If we need additional evidence (POA, company registration, ship-to mapping), list them and we'll request from Brendan.

Brendan 94 if you can send whichever is fastest (notarized scan + POA if available, or DocuSign link + audit report), we'll triage. We may need a short attestation from your legal saying the scanned copy is a true representation of the original.

My ask: please send file and a preferred timeline for mailing originals if required.

- Rishi
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Putting invoice 2027-04-NW-6721 on hold until we have acceptable evidence. For our acceptance checklist:
- Notarized wet-ink copy scanned to PDF: ACCEPTABLE for most states if notarization is properly completed and the signatory matches EIN ownership.
- E-signed DocuSign: ACCEPTABLE if DocuSign audit report is provided (signer identity method, IP/time, and certificate of completion).
- If the document is a state-specific resale certificate (e.g., Texas Form 01-339): we require the exact state form or a certified equivalent.

We also need either: a signed Power of Attorney (if the signer is not on file) OR matching corporate registry that shows the signatory's authority. If they provide a scanned notarized affidavit, include a short email from legal attesting the signer99s authority.

I99ll hold the invoice and pause collection activities until we mark it cleared. Lauren, please flag billing backlog if this hold extends beyond 7 business days.

- Kim
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
